headline: What Will Gold Prices Look Like Next Week After a Sharp Drop This Week?
summary: SJC gold bar prices fell by 3.2 million VND per tael compared with the end of last week, while world gold traded around 4,285 USD per ounce. Analysts are divided on next week's outlook.
why: Gold is a traditional store of value and a benchmark for safe-haven demand, and domestic Vietnamese gold prices often diverge from world prices due to local supply rules.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Gold prices in Vietnam fell over the week while world gold was trading near 4,285 USD per ounce.
